questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: 'This debt is not mine' or 'I never had this product'; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: 'I already paid': only a payment of this past-due amount (a past payoff or closure is a dispute).
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period instead of a day: 'next week', 'end of the month', 'when my salary comes'.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full past-due amount is too much.
intents.human: A request to speak to a human.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain why I am calling once I know I am speaking with {title} {last_name}.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time should I call back, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Is there another time that works?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak about this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. I will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know, and sorry for the trouble.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account, and I can only continue once they are answered.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I can't continue without checking your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has a past-due amount of {amount}, which is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date has to be today or later. Which day would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day can you pay {amount}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can take is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't take a payment promise today.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you with our restructuring team, who can talk that through with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Before I transfer you, can I help you with anything?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I can't change a saved promise on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

assumptions: The brief names no currency. Amounts are spoken in 'dollars' (the default).
Rule 1 says the call is recorded, so the opening says 'We record this call.' Rule 1 also forbids naming collections, debt, payment or the product before verification, and the opening does not.
Callback days are today or the next business day (rule 6). business_days_only is false because rule 6 allows today without requiring it to be a business day.
Callback max_asks is 2: the first ask, plus one more ask after a time outside the window (rule 7).
Rule 3: confirmation is asked at most twice. If the customer asks a question, the agent answers it first, and the ask that follows counts as the second ask.
Identity: date of birth first, sent as %Y-%m-%d, then phone_last4 as 4 digits. Field names come from the verify_identity enum. Numeric-only dates are read day, month, year (rule 11).

Rule 13: when the day_month_swapped hint comes back, the agent asks for the date of birth again with the month as a word. This gets a full date for the retry, not only the month. The retry is not counted as a wrong answer.
Unreadable answers come back with ok=false and are not counted (tool API), so reject_values is empty.
Three wrong answers in total end the check, across both questions (rule 12), so max_wrong_per_question is null.
Rule 15: asking what the call is about counts as declining (purpose_is_decline true). Other side questions (robot, scam) are answered and are not a decline (question_is_decline false).
Floor names: 'minimum payment' for credit cards and 'instalment' for loans, from the minimum_payment and instalment_amount fields (rule 25).

Persuasion ladder (rule 30): attempt 1 is the full amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, the engine uses the last business day of next week. Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
Deadlines are the n-th business day after today, so they are always business days. previous_business_day is kept as a safeguard only.
The brief has no rule about offering another turn after a recorded promise. The default (ask_anything_else true) is used.
Brief A never uses add_note: notes are disabled and every note value is empty.
Rule 45 gives two closes for 'I don't want to talk' said twice: before verification, not_verified/declined; after verification, no_promise/refused.
Rule 46: if a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason, not as promise.
Rule 36: a recorded promise cannot be changed on the call; the customer is told to use the mobile app.
The brief covers one product per call. The multi-product settings keep their defaults.
Every tool reports success with a boolean 'ok' (tool API), so each response success check is ok == true.
The schedule_callback tool takes separate date and time fields, so cb_date and cb_time are used.
